import sqlite3

# 端到端数据流：建表 -> 写 -> 读 -> 归一化输出
conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
cur = conn.cursor()
cur.execute('PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON')
cur.executescript('''
CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE posts (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
);
''')
cur.executemany('INSERT INTO users(id, name) VALUES (?, ?)', [(7, 'bob'), (9, 'ann')])
cur.executemany('INSERT INTO posts(id, user_id, title) VALUES (?, ?, ?)',
                [(1, 9, 'p1'), (2, 9, 'p2'), (3, 7, 'p3')])
conn.commit()

rows = cur.execute('''
SELECT p.id, p.title, u.id, u.name
FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id
ORDER BY p.id
''').fetchall()

# 归一化：实体表按主键去重，另存顺序索引
users = {}
posts = {}
order = []
for pid, title, uid, name in rows:
    users[uid] = {'id': uid, 'name': name}
    posts[pid] = {'id': pid, 'title': title, 'user_id': uid}
    order.append(pid)

print('rows=%d' % len(rows))
print('unique_users=%d' % len(users))
print('unique_posts=%d' % len(posts))
print('order=%s' % order)
print('join_user_objects=%d' % len(rows))
print('dedup_saved=%d' % (len(rows) - len(users)))

# 反向还原：由实体表重建嵌套结构
restored = [{'id': posts[pid]['id'], 'title': posts[pid]['title'],
             'user': users[posts[pid]['user_id']]} for pid in order]
print('roundtrip_first=%s' % restored[0])

# 事务回滚：违反外键约束的写入不得留下脏数据
before = cur.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts').fetchone()[0]
try:
    cur.execute('INSERT INTO posts(id, user_id, title) VALUES (?, ?, ?)', (4, 999, 'ghost'))
    conn.commit()
except sqlite3.IntegrityError as e:
    conn.rollback()
after = cur.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts').fetchone()[0]
print('fk_violation_blocked=%s' % (before == after))
print('posts_after_failed_insert=%d' % after)
